errors.text_span: Секторът "Твърди горива" е показан в синьо-зелено
errors.evidence: The slice for "Твърди горива" (0.4%) is a very light, almost white-teal color. Describing it as "синьо-зелено" (blue-green/teal) is highly confusing, as there is a much larger and more prominent teal slice (18.5% for "Електрическа енергия") on the chart. This mischaracterizes the color of the slice.

errors.text_span: докато секторът "Природен газ" е в зелено
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slice for "Природен газ" is green. While the legend key for this category is green, the actual slice on the chart (0.2%) is a very dark, indistinct color (dark purple or grey), not green.

errors.text_span: Няма допълнителни етикети с проценти или визуално подчертани сектори, освен вече споменатите.
errors.evidence: This sentence falsely claims there are no additional percentage labels on the chart. The figure clearly shows percentage values as labels next to each pie slice, in addition to the percentages listed in the legend.
